info.title: VietGara API
info.description: Public REST/JSON API of the VietGara platform (API Specification). Generated from vietgara-proto.

tags.name: CustomerService
tags.description:
CustomerService manages a garage's customers (FRD 3.4). Reads need
PERMISSION_CUSTOMER_READ, changes PERMISSION_CUSTOMER_WRITE.

tags.name: PartnerService
tags.description:
PartnerService manages suppliers and insurers (FR-CUS-04). Reads need
PERMISSION_PARTNER_READ, changes PERMISSION_PARTNER_WRITE.

tags.name: VehicleService
tags.description:
VehicleService manages vehicles (FRD 3.4). Filter by customer with
?customerId=. Reads need PERMISSION_CUSTOMER_READ, changes
PERMISSION_CUSTOMER_WRITE.

tags.name: AccountService
tags.description: AccountService manages the signed-in account's own profile.

tags.name: AuthService
tags.description:
AuthService handles sign-up, sign-in, sessions, e-mail verification and
password reset (FRD 3.1). Google sign-in uses the OAuth redirect routes
GET /api/v1/auth/google/login and /callback, which are plain HTTP handlers.

tags.name: LicenseService
tags.description: LicenseService is the garage-facing side of License Management.

tags.name: LicenseAdminService
tags.description: LicenseAdminService is for platform admins only (FR-LIC-05).

tags.name: RoleService
tags.description:
RoleService lets a garage owner manage the roles shared by their garages.
Every call acts on the signed-in owner's own roles.

tags.name: StaffGroupService
tags.description:
StaffGroupService manages a garage's staff groups. Listing needs
PERMISSION_STAFF_READ; changes are owner-only.

tags.name: InvitationService
tags.description:
InvitationService handles staff invitations: the garage side needs
PERMISSION_STAFF_WRITE; the /me side is the invited account.

tags.name: StaffService
tags.description:
StaffService manages a garage's members. Reads need
PERMISSION_STAFF_READ, changes PERMISSION_STAFF_WRITE. Members join
through InvitationService.

content.description: PNG, JPEG or WebP image, at most 1 MB (base64 in JSON).

days.description:
1 to 366 days added to the current period end (or to now when
already expired); reactivates past-due and suspended subscriptions.

typeDayOfWeek.description:
Represents a day of the week.

 - MONDAY: Monday
 - TUESDAY: Tuesday
 - WEDNESDAY: Wednesday
 - THURSDAY: Thursday
 - FRIDAY: Friday
 - SATURDAY: Saturday
 - SUNDAY: Sunday

phone.description: Optional contact phone, unique across accounts; used to look staff up.

emailVerified.description:
False until the e-mail OTP is confirmed; unverified accounts cannot use
garage, staff or business APIs.

v1Account.description: Account is a VietGara login (owner or staff member).

v1AccountStatus.description: AccountStatus is the lifecycle of a login account (Database Design 2.1).

v1AuthProvider.description: AuthProvider is how the account signed up (FR-IAM-01).

v1CandidateMembership.description: CandidateMembership is where a looked-up account stands with the garage.

phone.description: Unique per garage among live customers; stored normalized.

personalDataConsent.description: Personal-data consent (Decree 13/2023/ND-CP); every change is logged.

v1Customer.description: Customer is a vehicle owner served by one garage (FR-CUS-01).

closed.description: True when the garage does not open that day.

v1DailyHours.description: DailyHours is the opening time of one weekday (FR-TEN-05).

v1Entitlements.description:
Entitlements is what a garage may currently use, derived from its
owner's subscription; the web admin uses it to lock UI.

code.description:
Stable, machine-readable code the client translates, e.g.
VALIDATION_ERROR, EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED, OTP_EXPIRED, PLAN_LIMIT_REACHED.

message.description:
English, developer-facing description; clients show a localized text
for `code` instead.

v1Error.description: Error describes why a request failed.

field.description: JSON name of the field, e.g. "email" or "garage.name".

issue.description: Machine-readable problem: required, invalid, too_long, taken, ...

v1ErrorDetail.description: ErrorDetail is one invalid request field.

v1ErrorResponse.description:
ErrorResponse is the body of every non-2xx REST response:
`{"error": {"code", "message", "details"}}`.

v1Feature.description: Feature is a module a plan may include.

v1Garage.description: Garage is one tenant (branch) of an owner account (FR-TEN-01/02).

v1GarageAccess.description: GarageAccess is what the signed-in account may do in the garage.

v1GarageStatus.description:
GarageStatus: an inactive garage is hidden from staff and read-only for
its owner until reactivated (FR-TEN-02).

groupIds.description: Staff groups the member joins on acceptance.

v1Invitation.description:
Invitation asks an existing account to join a garage (FR-TEN-04). It is
e-mailed to the account and expires after 7 days.

data.description:
Garages the account owns or is an active member of; staff do not see
inactive garages.

v1Locale.description:
Locale is the account's interface and e-mail language. Vietnamese is the
default (NFR-US-01).

v1NumberingTemplates.description:
NumberingTemplates configures document numbers (FR-TEN-05). Placeholders:
{YYYY}, {YY}, {MM}, {DD} and {SEQ:n} (sequence padded to n digits),
e.g. "BG-{YYYY}{MM}-{SEQ:4}".

resendAvailableAt.description: A new OTP cannot be requested before this time.

v1OtpChallenge.description: OtpChallenge tells the client how long the e-mailed OTP is valid.

total.description: Total number of items matching the query, across all pages.

pageSize.description: The page size that was applied.

v1Pagination.description:
Pagination describes the page returned by every List call (API
Specification Section 1.1): lists are requested with `page` (1-based,
default 1) and `page_size` (default 20, max 100).

v1Partner.description:
Partner is a parts supplier or insurer in the garage's directory
(FR-CUS-04).

v1Permission.description:
Permission is one action a staff member may perform in a garage
(FR-IAM-03). The catalog is fixed by the platform and grouped by module,
each module offering a read and/or a write action; garage owners combine
permissions into roles. A write permission includes the read permission
of its module. Owners always hold every permission; every active member
may read the garage profile.

 - PERMISSION_GARAGE_WRITE: Edit the garage profile, configuration and logo.
 - PERMISSION_STAFF_WRITE: Invite, activate/deactivate and remove staff, and change their groups.
 - PERMISSION_CUSTOMER_READ: Customers and their vehicles.
 - PERMISSION_PARTNER_READ: Suppliers and insurers.

module.description:
Module the permission belongs to, e.g. "customer", used to group the
role editor.

action.description: "read" or "write": the permission's column in the role editor.

code.description: Unique, e.g. "pro"; "trial" is the plan every new owner starts on.

price.description: Price per billing cycle in the smallest currency unit (VND).

isActive.description: Inactive plans cannot be chosen; existing subscribers keep them.

maxStaff.description:
Staff members across all garages, excluding the owner and counting
pending invitations.

maxTransactionsPerDay.description:
Business documents (quotes, repair orders, settlements) created per
calendar day (Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh).

v1PlanLimits.description: PlanLimits caps usage across all garages of the subscribing owner.

isDefault.description: Created by the platform; still editable.

groupCount.description: Number of staff groups using the role.

defaultPermissions.description:
For a default role, the permissions the platform created it with: what
the role editor's "Reset to default" restores. Empty for other roles.

v1Role.description:
Role is a named set of permissions defined by a garage owner and shared
by all the owner's garages. Default roles are created when the owner
verifies their e-mail.

v1Session.description: Session is what every successful sign-in returns.

owner.description: The garage owner; cannot be deactivated, removed or grouped.

groupIds.description: Staff groups of this garage the member belongs to.

permissions.description: Union of the permissions of the member's groups.

v1Staff.description: Staff is an account's membership of a garage (FR-TEN-04).

v1StaffCandidate.description: StaffCandidate is an existing account found by e-mail or phone.

v1StaffGroup.description:
StaffGroup is a set of staff in one garage that all receive the
permissions of the group's role.

v1StaffStatus.description: StaffStatus: inactive staff keep their record but lose access.

v1Subscription.description:
Subscription is an owner account's license covering all their garages
(FR-LIC-01..04).

v1SubscriptionStatus.description:
SubscriptionStatus (LLD 3.1): past_due is read-only during the grace
period, suspended and cancelled are locked.

v1SubscriptionSummary.description: SubscriptionSummary is one row of the platform admin's subscription list.

v1Usage.description: Usage is the owner's current consumption of the plan limits.

licensePlate.description: Unique per garage (ignoring punctuation and case).

v1Vehicle.description: Vehicle belongs to one customer of the garage (FR-CUS-02).

refreshToken.description:
The refresh token of the current session; it is rotated so the new
session carries the verified claim.

bearer.description: Access token issued by the auth endpoints: `Bearer <token>`.
bearer.name: Authorization
